page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m2.large is a burstable instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core with hyper-threading (2 threads per core) on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the lower tiers of performance. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests scored 1300.19 and 2402.69 respectively, falling into the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth tests show a significant drop from 186.46 GB/sec for cached small-block reads to 20.68 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, which is categorized in the bottom 10%. Geekbench scores also reflect these limitations, with a single-core score of 1045.0 and a multi-core score of 1850.0.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and low baseline network bandwidth, this instance is designed for workloads with low CPU utilization that experience occasional spikes. It is not suitable for continuous high-compute tasks, large-scale database operations, or memory-intensive applications, as demonstrated by its low Passmark database operations score of 677.83 and Redis SET throughput of 2.57 million operations per second. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, development environments, code compilation testing, and low-traffic background tasks.
